target_text: // Round-to-nearest-even (a tie goes to the even bf16) bias of bf16_rne.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The name RNE_BIAS_0X7FFF and the body of bf16_rne (bits += bias, then the shift) say where the bias is added. The tie rule is the one fact left.

Proposed:
```cpp
// Round-to-nearest-even (a tie goes to the even bf16) bias of bf16_rne.
```
